reviews.title: Great & Easy Storage Upgrade for PS5
reviews.comment: Works as advertised one of the more cost effective options for a PS5 storage upgrade. Read Write performance comparable to onboard storage. Upgrade process was surprisingly easy. Great experience overall, highly recommended. Sony's website has the installation video for all PS5 versions but generally it's sliding /popping off a plastic panel removing a small metal door with a Philips screwdriver seating and installing the drive in the port and reversing the process to seal it up.  PS5 will need to format it on fist boot and you will need to choose / move installed games from the onboard storage to the new drive. I haven't noticed any difference in load times between the two so you may as well re-direct all new game installs to the new drive.

reviews.title: Fantastic storage expansion for a PS5!!
reviews.comment: I purchased this for my first gen PS5. I was looking at different options at a reasonable price and this was a great deal. The Lexar NM790 is a fantastic option to expand the internal storage, it was easy to install (just took a couple minutes literally!) and works perfectly with the console. There is no lag and games load up super fast. I would highly recommend this if you're looking for a capable SSD internal storage for your PC or compatible gaming console.
